objective: mean GroupKFold(5) log loss on 80 training trips (minimise)

search_space.n_estimators: int, 100-500: number of trees; more trees stabilise probabilities
search_space.max_depth: int, 4-32: tree depth cap; controls overfitting on noisy GPS
search_space.min_samples_split: int, 2-20: minimum samples to split a node
search_space.min_samples_leaf: int, 1-10: leaf smoothing, improves probability estimates
search_space.max_features: categorical {sqrt, log2, 1.0}: feature subsampling per split
